goal: Keep Whisper Relay transport on real WHISPER while eliminating visible [SSWR1] transport spam and the live SpamGuardHot nil crash by removing the ChatFrame_OnEvent wrapper and using WIM's native Block filter for the reserved protocol prefix.
notes: Live evidence at 23:28-23:29 showed valid [SSWR1] E lifecycle packets in WIM windows plus SummonScout_WhisperRelaySpamGuardHot.lua:206 attempt to call a nil value. Root cause: repeated hot/reload could chain ChatFrame_OnEvent wrappers; an old Shutdown nilled its captured base while a newer wrapper still referenced it. V3 removes ChatFrame_OnEvent ownership entirely. Relay still uses SendChatMessage(..., WHISPER, ...). When WIM is present, SummonScout installs escaped pattern %[SSWR1%] = Block into WIM_Filters; OptionalDeps loads WIM first. Zero-idle handshake remains unchanged. After updating from a runtime already affected by the dangling wrapper, perform one /reload to rebuild FrameXML cleanly.
